_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY — this file shows the structure of deployments.json. Do NOT use as-is: replace host, ers_username, and dataconnect.cert_path with your real values, then set passwords with 'cisco-ise-mcp set-credential <slug>'. Your real registry is auto-created blank in the per-user config dir; manage it with 'cisco-ise-mcp add/update/remove' (or your AI agent) instead of editing by hand. SECURITY: every verify_ssl / dataconnect.verify_ssl here is true (the secure default) — keep it true in production; set it to false ONLY for a self-signed lab, which disables MITM protection for the ISE admin/Data Connect credentials. NOTES: (1) monitoring_enabled controls the Monitoring API (MAPI/MnT, ise_mnt_*) — it is OPT-IN (omit it on a pre-existing deployment to keep MnT on; new deployments default it to false) and needs the ERS account in ISE's 'MnT Admin' group. (2) dataconnect.host is OPTIONAL — leave it empty (or omit it) to run Data Connect on the same admin host (see radius-only); set it to the MnT/Monitoring node when Data Connect lives on a different IP/FQDN than the primary Admin node (see tacacs-only). (3) dataconnect.os_trust=true validates a CA-signed Data Connect certificate against the OS/default CA store, so no cert_path is needed (see vpn-only); leave it false and set cert_path for a self-signed cert.
